title: LiquidLoans (PulseChain) Liquity-v1 fork — TVL $4.28M->$1.63M is a PLS price artifact + repayments; no unprivileged path
closed_reasons: The pass-2 address 0x9159f1d2a9f51998fc9ab03fbd8f265ab14a1b3b is the LOAN governance token, not the CDP; the CDP is the LiquidLoans Liquity-v1 fork (BorrowerOperations 0xa09bB56B..., VaultManager 0xD79bfb86..., StabilityPool 0x7bFD4066..., USDL 0x0dEEd148...).
All admin surfaces are owner-renounced: owner()=0 on VaultManager, BorrowerOperations, StabilityPool, ActivePool, DefaultPool, CollSurplusPool, PriceFeed, LOANStaking, CommunityIssuance.
No vault is liquidatable: 96 vaults, minimum ICR 1.5156, median 1.989, max 7.249; MCR=1.10; 0 vaults below MCR (block 27,868,978).

The oracle is not manipulable by a single transaction: primary Fetch oracle fresh and reporter-based; secondary is a period-limited PulseX-V2 TWAP; both within 1.1% of each other and of market WPLS ($5.68e-6 vs oracle $5.66e-6); status=fetchWorking.

Every exit is msg.sender-scoped: CollSurplusPool.claimColl requires msg.sender==BorrowerOperations and passes the caller; StabilityPool.withdrawFromSP and LOANStaking withdrawals are per-depositor; both revert for a fresh caller.
Borrowing creates no value: max borrow = coll*price/1.10, and the minted USDL is worth less than the collateral's market value (test E: $5,062 vs $5,636 per 1M PLS).

TVL drop reconciled: protocol oracle fell 9.4059e-6 -> 4.8683e-6 (-48%) from 13 to 19 Oct while system collateral fell only 6.3% (377.0e9 -> 353.2e9 PLS) and debt fell 21.6% (repayments/redemptions); no outflow trail.

caveats: Point-in-time 2026-10-23 (block 27,868,978); the vault set, prices and the secondary-oracle owner must be re-read before any action.
H-O ~$2.16M is mark-to-market at PLS $5.6768e-6 / USDL $0.98947 / LOAN $4.1366e-7 and is user-owned, self-service only (not attacker-extractable).
P risk stated but not proven: the secondary oracle is a UUPS proxy owned by a Gnosis Safe; a Safe compromise could re-price the oracle and liquidate/drain (key risk, not an unprivileged path).
The Base deployment advertised by liquidloans.io is out of scope of this PulseChain OPEN.
DefiLlama's LiquidLoans adapter (module liquidloans-io/index.js) is not present in the current public DefiLlama-Adapters tree; the reconciliation uses on-chain reads + DefiLlama price marks.
No secrets or keyed RPC URLs are stored in this folder; all work is read-only.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 from LiquidLoans: the $4.28M->$1.63M TVL fall is the PLS oracle price dropping 48% plus a 6.3% collateral outflow (repayments/redemptions), the protocol is a Liquity-v1 fork with all admin renounced, the oracle is at market and two-sourced, no vault is liquidatable, and every exit is msg.sender-scoped; only a ~0.2% intended peg arbitrage exists.
